**Unblocked — `Blocked-by: #6108` resolves.**

#6108 closed `completed`: *"The other two sort-axis consumers still re-derive sortability from field type — ListView's sort …"*. That was the hot-file serialization on the sort axis this card was waiting behind.

Returned to `pm:queue`. Two things for whoever picks it up, both from the unlock scan rather than from the card:

1. **Re-measure the file face on the merged ref first.** #6108 landed on the same sort-axis consumers this card names, so part of what is described here may already be resolved — a card returned by the unlock scan is a candidate, not a verdict.
2. **This card also references `objectstack-ai/objectstack#10235`**, which is a cross-repo reference and is *not* the `Blocked-by:` upstream. objectui consumes objectstack as a published package, so if any part of the fix depends on server behaviour, "upstream merged" is not the test — "the installed package exposes it" is. Establish which side the fix lands on before assuming this is a pure objectui change.

Claim: PM session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q` (`domain:ui` execution seat, objectui). Branch `claude/issue-6455-listview-sort-persist-leak`. Dispatched this round to one `os-dev` agent, in its own worktree. Picked as the Bug tier's cleanest card after this round's unlock scan refilled that tier.

Three measurements taken before dispatching, so the order does not rest on the card's memory of the tree:

**The one-consumer claim holds exactly.** `filterPlatformSortableSort` has three occurrences repo-wide: its definition in `packages/core/src/utils/column-sortability.ts`, its test, and **one** non-test consumer, `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`. The picker is indeed not behind it.

**The file face is located and both files are free.** The picker is `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (3739 lines; `onSortChange` ×10, `isPlatformSortableField` ×3 — the post-#6108 predicate). The persisting `ObjectView` is `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` (`onSortChange` ×3, `persistViewPatch` ×19), which came free when PR #6573 merged at 14:06Z.

**A collision was checked and ruled out, not assumed.** #6460 is in flight on `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — a different file with the same component name. It carries **0** `onSortChange` and **0** `persistView`, against a positive control of 48 hits for `sort` in the same file, so the zero is a real absence rather than a pattern that never reached the file. No serialization needed between the two cards.

⛔ Out of the dispatched scope, stated to the agent: `filterPlatformSortableSort`'s own definition, `ObjectGrid`'s use of it (#5729 already closed the grid seam and is the precedent this converges on), and anything server-side under `objectstack-ai/objectstack#10235`. `RelatedList` is to be **confirmed** in or out by measurement and reported, ⛔ never swept in.

The correctness constraint the order leads with: **the in-use exception must survive.** Filtering the array the picker renders from would make a platform-refused sort unremovable, which is a worse defect than the leak. Listing and persisting have to separate.

**Post-merge verification — clean.** PR #6583 merged 16:52:05Z as `bd2f56ae5211`; verified against `origin/main` at `bd2f56ae5`, not against the PR diff or the dev's report.

This check is not "is the fix present" — it is **did the deliberate omissions survive, and did the rejected options sneak in**.

| what had to hold | reading on `origin/main` |
|---|---|
| the fix funnels every emit | `emitSortChange` at `ListView.tsx:2530`, single `filterPlatformSortableSort(next, platformSortability)` call at `:2535`; every `onSortChange` in the component crosses it |
| ⛔ **the in-use exception is NOT filtered out of the render leg** | intact at `:2492` — `if (inUse.has(field.value)) fields.push(…)` still lists a platform-refused field while the current sort names it |
| ⛔ #5729's grid seam untouched (it is the evidence, not a target) | `ObjectGrid.tsx` still carries 3 `filterPlatformSortableSort` mentions; `git diff` across the merge for `packages/plugin-grid/` is **empty** |
| ⛔ `RelatedList` untouched | `git diff` across the merge for `packages/plugin-detail/` is **empty** |
| no-signal behaviour unchanged | the filter is gated on a truthy `platformSortability`; with no served projection the pre-objectstack#10235 path stands |

**The in-use exception is the one that mattered.** The tidier-looking wrong fix here is to filter the refused field out of the *list* as well — which would have removed the user's only way to delete a sort the server refuses outright, turning a persistence leak into a trapped row. It survived, and the reason is now written into the source above the boundary rather than living in this card.

**The card's open question was answered, not assumed.** It asked for `RelatedList` to be *confirmed* out of scope. The PR measured it with a positive control: 84 `sort` hits (proving the surface is present, so a zero elsewhere in the file is a real absence), 1 `onSortChange` which is an inbound prop whose handler only touches component state, 0 `persistViewPatch`. Out of scope by construction, established rather than asserted.

**Consumer census moved in the right direction.** This card measured `filterPlatformSortableSort` at exactly one non-test consumer (`ObjectGrid`). It is now two — `ObjectGrid` and `ListView` — with the render leg `isPlatformSortableField` still at its four.

⚠️ Instrument note, recorded because the zero nearly stood: the first census ran with a `-- 'packages/*/src'` pathspec, which matched **nothing**, and both the finding query and its control came back empty. The control is what exposed it. A pathspec that matches no files reports every query as a clean zero.
